lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Nix, get your cameras out of my face [beat] before I shove this mop somewhere the sun doesn't shine, you little snitch!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Oh, I'm just documenting your progress, because every floor tile you scrub [beat] is another apology for stealing that scooter from the library.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I told you it was a mistake, I didn't know it belonged to your sister [beat] and I definitely didn't mean to crash it into the school fountain!

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: Whether it was an accident or not, Bruno, you're the one [beat] who decided to lie about it and blame the innocent delivery driver.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Now you're working off the repair costs, and honestly, seeing you [beat] in that yellow jumpsuit is the highlight of my entire school year!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Everyone is laughing at me, and Nix is literally charging me [beat] for the water I'm using to clean his own disgusting gym locker.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It’s called inflation, Bruno, and since you spent years taking [beat] lunch money from everyone else, it’s finally time for you to pay up.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: If I see one more speck of dust on these trophies, Nix [beat] might just convince me to make you clean the cafeteria ovens too.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: The ovens? That’s inhumane, I’ve already spent four hours [beat] scraping old gum from under the desks with my bare fingernails!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Maybe next time you’ll think twice before trashing [beat] someone’s property just because you thought it looked cool in the dark.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I hate this school, I hate this job, and I especially [beat] hate the fact that you’re actually making me learn how to be a decent person!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That’s the spirit, Bruno, because once you finish the parking lot [beat] I might actually consider letting you ride the scooter once for free!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that’s how the school bully became the head janitor's assistant [beat] proving that in Nix’s world, kindness is the only currency that actually matters.
